sloka: यदि कश्चित्प्रदाता मे विषस्याद्य भवेदिह ।क्षिप्रं वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येयं पतिना विना ।। ५.२४.३६।।।।
transliteration: yadi kaścitpradātā me viṣasyādya bhavediha ।kṣipraṁ vaivasvataṁ devaṁ paśyeyaṁ patinā vinā ।। 5.24.36।।।।

translations.english: 'O lady of intoxicating eyes range in the company of the demon king, the delightful gardens and mountain ranges filled with gardens.
